common_ground.definition: The part of a position that both people accept. Every polite disagreement starts by naming it.
common_ground.example: Find the common ground first — both of you want this project to succeed.

dpn_anchoring.definition: The first number of a negotiation, which every later number is measured against.
dpn_anchoring.example: The seller opened at 120,000, and every figure after that was measured against it.

soft_power.definition: Influence achieved through attraction and information rather than force or payment.
